description: Synthesize speech from text via DeepSeek's TTS API and save it as a local audio file. Returns the output file path; play it with a local player or pass it to the user. Markdown syntax is stripped before synthesis by default.

format.description: Audio format: wav (default) or raw pcm (24 kHz, 16-bit signed, mono).

output_path.description: Where to write the audio file. Defaults to a temp file; the resolved path is in the result.

text.description: The text to speak. Must not be empty.

name: deepseek_tts
title: DeepSeek TTS (Text-to-Speech)
